summary: Fix confirmed. With the soft open-file limit at 76 (46 descriptors open after CUDA init + 30), converting a 62-module model at the fix parent 9575f7d8b2af quantized every module, then failed in compilation with RuntimeError " ## Error opening file '.../qtensors/model.layers.1.safetensors': Too many open files (errno=24)" at exllamav3/loader/safetensors.py:302: handles cached across modules exhausted the limit. At the fix 4710c012a51f the same conversion under the same limit completed and wrote model.safetensors. Attempt 001 lost its report to the same limit; this attempt restores the limit before reporting.
what_ran: repro.py writes a tiny random 60-layer LlamaForCausalLM (hidden 128) with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct tokenizer files, initialises CUDA, lowers the soft open-file limit, and runs convert_model parser/prepare/main in-process (-b 4, 4x256 calibration) on physical GPU 1.
limits: The limit is set relative to this process's descriptor count; the real default limit (1048576 here) is not exhausted by small models. The listed latest affected commit 647bb7d549b8 was not run (unbuildable extension). Where exactly the descriptors accumulate (conversion vs compilation) was not instrumented; the failure surfaced in compilation.
modifications: Environment only: the process's soft RLIMIT_NOFILE is lowered to (open descriptors after CUDA init) + 30 = 76 before conversion and restored after. Upstream is not modified.

model.repo_id: synthetic tiny LlamaForCausalLM generated by repro.py (tokenizer from Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct)
